description: Execute an arbitrary shell command on the remote server. May modify the system. Commands classified destructive or privileged go through the approval gate; approvalPolicy on the profile decides whether that is a prompt, an automatic allow, or a refusal. Single-line only: a command containing a line break is refused, so upload a multi-line script with sftp-upload and run it by path.

session.description: Run in an existing interactive session (stateful)

name: run-command
